title: Frappe ERPNext 13.0.0 before 15.122.0 and 16.x before 16.50.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in an…
description: Frappe ERPNext versions 13.0.0 before 15.122.0 and 16.x before 16.50.0 have a missing authorization vulnerability in the Accounts module. This flaw allows authenticated users with the Accounts User role who can edit Bank Transactions to manipulate reconciliation states of vouchers outside their permission scope. The vulnerability arises because the system checks permissions only on the Bank Transaction, not on each voucher referenced in reconciliation requests.
